name: wbfm
label: FM broadcast (mono)
description: Wideband FM receiver authored as one cross-env doc. The node half reads 2.4 MS/s IQ off an RTL-SDR (or any Soapy device with a matching `args` string) and a Channelizer pulls a 240 kS/s VFO to baseband. A TeeIqF32 fans the channelizer output into two paths: a server-side FFT → LogMagU8 chain that terminates at the `ui:fft` sentinel (env_split inserts a WsBridgeTxFftU8 on the node half with ui_name="fft"), and the main audio chain where a 5× decim to 48 kHz, phase-discriminator FM demod, and AudioSink run in the browser. The `tee.out0 → decim.in` wire crosses the environment boundary; env_split auto-inserts a WsBridgeTx/WsBridgeRx pair and allocates stream_ids from CROSS_ENV_STREAM_BASE (1000) in wire order.
